 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform zero rectangle is the destination; the other non-background
    # colors form the source pattern to mirror into it.
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not zero_cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zero_cells), max(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zero_cells), max(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in source), max(r for r, c in source)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in source), max(c for r, c in source)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            out[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = grid[sr0 + dr][sc1 - dc]
    return out
"
